# Third-party material

`threat-composer-v1.schema.json` is an unmodified copy of the JSON Schema published by AWS Threat Composer
(Apache-2.0, https://github.com/awslabs/threat-composer, commit 84f5628113ba8db6253e17c6b7afc86c6b4bc0eb).
It is used only by the test suite. See `../NOTICE` for the full list of reused material and any modifications.
